study type: Laboratory investigation of biological samples using 16S rRNA gene sequencing
cohort: Participants included gender-reassignment patients contributing ovarian tissue and follicular fluid, and women undergoing Caesarean sections contributing ovarian cortex tissue samples.
finding: The study found negligible microbial reads in ovarian tissue and follicular fluid samples after decontamination, suggesting no specific ovarian microbiome exists beyond contamination.
mod_finding: Ovarian cortex samples from women undergoing Caesarean sections showed negligible microbial reads, indicating no specific ovarian microbiome in this group.
